title_as_printed: P71: Predicting amyloid-ß deposition status in amnestic mild cognitive impairment using neuropsychological profiles.

registry_codes.Sample_N_Approx: 67 - 33 amyloid-PET positive aMCI / 34 amyloid-PET negative aMCI. The abstract prints this explicitly and redundantly ("67 aMCI patients (N = 67; 33 aMCI with amyloid positive ... and 34 aMCI with amyloid negative ...)"), and the two groups sum exactly to the

Task_Type.reason: The study discriminates amyloid-PET status (a biomarker) within aMCI. There is no MCI-vs-HC contrast, so T1 does not apply, and biomarker-status discrimination is T4.
Task_Type.quote: The association of cognitive test scores and dichotomized Aβ deposition status was examined using logistic regression models in patients with aMCI.

Category.reason: Two readings. C5 alone: the analysed predictors are neuropsychological test scores, the primary domain. C5;C1: amyloid PET (and MRI) supplies the outcome label. The registry's C5 carries the primary domain and omits only the secondary imaging domain that serves as reference standard.
Category.quote: All participants underwent Seoul Neuropsychological Screening Battery for a comprehensive neuropsychological test battery and brain MRI. To determine Aβ deposition status, each participant underwent amyloid PET scans using 18F-florbetaben.

Validation_Type.reason: Logistic regression and ROC were run on the whole sample of 67. No cross-validation, test partition or external set is reported, so absence of reporting = V2.
Validation_Type.quote: Receiver operating characteristic (ROC) curves were used to examine the predictive ability of cognitive test to detect Aβ deposition status in aMCI.

Sample_N_Approx.reason: The leading number 67 = 33 + 34, as printed. The registry string ends in truncated commentary, but its number is right.
Sample_N_Approx.quote: This is a cross-sectional study of 67 aMCI patients (N = 67; 33 aMCI with amyloid positive (Aβ-PET (+)), and 34 aMCI with amyloid negative (Aβ-PET (-))).

Publication_Year.reason: This is an abstract from the 2023 IPA International Congress. Crossref for doi 10.1017/S1041610223002478 gives International Psychogeriatrics 35(S1):119, issued 2023-12. The Elsevier-hosted PDF's metadata says '(2024)', which reflects re-hosting, not publication.

ADNI_Dependent.reason: The sample comes from a single Korean clinic (Pusan National University). ADNI is not used.
ADNI_Dependent.quote: 1 Department of Psychiatry, Pusan National University School of Medicine, Busan, Korea

notes: This is a one-page conference abstract (IPA 2023, poster P71), not a full paper, but all six codes can be supported from the abstract. is_model_study is true because logistic-regression/ROC discrimination of amyloid status is reported (combined AUC 0.833). The task is T4, so the study does not enter the T1-T3 classification subset.
